extName.description: The extension's name, shown in the store listing, the chrome://extensions row and the toolbar tooltip parent.

extDescription.message: Tabverse is an opinionated way of managing tabs.
extDescription.description: The extension's one-line description, shown in the store listing and on chrome://extensions.

extActionTitle.description: The toolbar button's tooltip, from action.default_title in the manifest.

popupCurrentTabverseFallback.description: Popup: what to call this window's tabverse when it has neither a name nor an id to show.

popupReplaceNewTitle.message: Start a new tabverse in this window?
popupReplaceNewTitle.description: Popup: the alert header when New tabverse is pressed while this window already has one.

popupReplaceNewBody.message: This window already has a tabverse ("$1"). It is saved automatically, so nothing is lost. Continuing closes it here and starts a new tabverse; the tabs in this window become part of it.
popupReplaceNewBody.description: Popup: the alert body for New tabverse over an existing tabverse. $1 is the current tabverse's name.

popupAddToWindowTitle.message: Add this tabverse to this window?
popupAddToWindowTitle.description: Popup: the alert header when adding a saved tabverse to a window that already has one.

popupAddToWindowBody.message: This window already has a tabverse ("$1"). It is saved automatically, so nothing is lost. Continuing makes "$2" the tabverse of this window and opens its $3 tab(s) here: the tabs already open in this window stay, and the ones of that tabverse already open here are reused.
popupAddToWindowBody.description: Popup: the alert body when adding a saved tabverse over the current one. $1 the current tabverse's name, $2 the one being added, $3 its number of tabs.

popupImportedOk.description: Popup: the success notice after importing a .tabverse file. $1 is the imported tabverse's name.

popupImportFailed.message: That file is not a Tabverse export.
popupImportFailed.description: Popup: the error notice when the chosen file cannot be imported.

popupLoading.description: Popup: shown while the tabverse list is being read.

popupNothingSaved.message: No tabverse saved yet. Every window you keep with Tabverse becomes one, and shows up here afterwards.
popupNothingSaved.description: Popup: the empty state when nothing has ever been saved.

popupNothingFound.message: Nothing found. Try fewer words, or a word from a tab title.
popupNothingFound.description: Popup: the empty state for a search that matched nothing.

popupNothingRecent.message: Nothing recent. Open a tabverse in a window and it shows up here.
popupNothingRecent.description: Popup: the empty state when there is nothing saved but the user is not searching.

popupSavedCount.description: Popup: the header count of saved tabverses. $1 is the number.

popupNewTabverse.description: Popup: the button that starts a new tabverse in this window.

popupNewTabverseTitleWhenOpen.message: Saves the current tabverse and starts a new one in this window
popupNewTabverseTitleWhenOpen.description: Popup: the New tabverse button's tooltip when this window already has a tabverse.

popupNewTabverseTitle.message: Starts a new tabverse in this window
popupNewTabverseTitle.description: Popup: the New tabverse button's tooltip when this window has no tabverse yet.

popupImport.description: Popup: the button that picks a .tabverse file to import.

popupImportTitle.message: Import a .tabverse file as a new tabverse

popupSearchPlaceholder.description: Popup: the placeholder in the search box.

popupResultOne.description: Popup: the list heading while searching, exactly one match. $1 is the number.

popupResultMany.description: Popup: the list heading while searching, more than one match. $1 is the number.

popupRecent.description: Popup: the list heading when not searching.

popupSearchedOnServer.description: Popup: the search-status line when the sync server answered the search.

popupSearchedOnDevice.description: Popup: the search-status line when the search ran against the local database.

popupNotDownloadedOne.description: Popup: how many search matches are still only on the server. $1 is the number.

popupNotDownloadedMany.description: Popup: how many search matches are still only on the server, more than one. $1 is the number.

popupConfirmReplace.description: Popup: the confirm button on the replace-this-window alert.

popupCancel.description: Popup: the cancel button on the replace-this-window alert.

popupRowGoTo.description: Popup: a saved row's tooltip when the tabverse is already open somewhere - clicking goes to it.

popupRowAddToWindow.description: Popup: a saved row's tooltip when the tabverse is not open - clicking adds it here.

popupTabCountOne.description: Popup: a saved row's tab count, exactly one. $1 is the number.

popupTabCountMany.description: Popup: a saved row's tab count, more than one. $1 is the number.

popupThisWindow.description: Popup: the tag on the row for the tabverse of the window the popup was opened from.

popupOpenInWindowOne.description: Popup: the badge on a row that is open elsewhere, exactly one window. $1 is the number.

popupOpenInWindowMany.description: Popup: the badge on a row that is open elsewhere, more than one window. $1 is the number.

popupGoToWindowOfTabverse.message: Go to the window of this tabverse
popupGoToWindowOfTabverse.description: Popup: the locate button's tooltip - switches to the window this tabverse is open in.

popupOpenInNewWindow.description: Popup: the folder-shared button's tooltip - opens the tabverse in a new window.

commonLoading.description: Shown while a view's data is still being read.

commonSomethingWentWrong.description: The error boundary's heading when a view crashed.

commonFilterCount.description: A filter box's count pill while filtering: $1 matching rows of $2 total.

commonFilterTotal.description: A filter box's count pill when not filtering: the total row count. $1 is the number.

commonFilterPlaceholder.description: The default placeholder of a filter box that was not given one.

commonClearFilter.description: A filter box's clear button, as a tooltip and an aria-label.

commonCollapseSidebarAria.description: The sidebar collapse button's accessible name.

commonExpandSidebar.description: The collapsed sidebar's logo button, which is the way back out of the rail.

commonPageIndicator.description: A pager's page position: $1 the current page, $2 the last.

commonRemoveAria.description: The accessible name of the x on a removable search tag.

searchTermsAria.description: The accessible name of the input in the scoped search box.
